name: zentao-member-ops
description: Member-aware ZenTao 21.7.1 access with synchronized multi-profile identity switching, real post-write UI evidence, daily Bug scans, cross-session solution packages, and risk-gated writes.

interface.shortDescription: 支持多身份切换，按成员权限安全操作禅道
interface.longDescription: 连接禅道开源版 21.7.1，支持保存多个禅道环境或成员身份并相互切换；新增或切换配置时自动同步活动 profile 与插件 MCP 启动配置，展示全部脱敏身份，并提醒重启 Codex 后核对身份。插件按活动账号的实际分组权限动态生成项目、Bug、需求和任务工具。所有禅道写入默认等待用户确认，写入后强制回读并要求展示真实禅道结果页截图。开发者成员默认每天 07:00 扫描新增 Bug，保存可跨会话交接的完整 JSON/Markdown 解决方案包，不自动修改源码或禅道。
capabilities: ZenTao project, Bug, story, and task reads
User-supplied first-run address, account, password, and project scope
Synchronized multi-profile connection storage, listing, and identity switching
Authenticated real ZenTao UI screenshot required after successful writes
Persistent scan cursors and retry queues across scheduled runs
Complete JSON and Markdown Bug solution packages for cross-session handoff
Permission-aware product, project, and execution creation
New Bug detection, attachment context, and source-backed analysis delivered in Codex
Codex-led Bug and requirement analysis, implementation, and verification
Cache invalidation plus authoritative refresh after successful writes
Manual or low-risk-only automatic confirmation with risky writes always human-confirmed
defaultPrompt: 首次配置禅道，向我收集地址、账号、密码和项目范围。
列出全部脱敏禅道身份，切换到我指定的 profile，并告诉我重启后的核对步骤。
检测开发者可见的新增 Bug，生成可跨会话交接的完整方案包。
预览并经我确认后执行禅道写入，然后展示真实结果页截图。
